title: Psalms 123
paragraphs: ¹ To you I lift my eyes, you who are enthroned in the heavens. ² As the eyes of servants look to the hand of their master, as the eyes of a maidservant look to the hand of her mistress, so our eyes look to the LORD our God, until he shows us his mercy. ³ Have mercy on us, LORD, have mercy on us, for we have endured great contempt. ⁴ We have suffered more than enough scorn from the complacent and contempt from the proud.
